name: SBD1
instructions: Fill EVERY field on the official cover form. The form's own warning is real: 'FAILURE TO PROVIDE / OR COMPLY WITH ANY OF THE ABOVE PARTICULARS MAY RENDER THE BID INVALID.'

fields_table.guidance: The deadline is absolute - late is dead, whatever the reason.
Names must match CIPC, CSD and the B-BBEE evidence EXACTLY - a mismatch is treated as misrepresentation at some buyers.
If not VAT-registered, write 'Not registered' - never leave the line blank.
Registration must be active AT CLOSING TIME; attach the CSD report the pack demands (several buyers reject the summary report and require the FULL report).
Generate a CURRENT PIN on eFiling per bid - stale PINs fail verification.
Tick the level box AND attach the certificate or sworn affidavit; the claim itself is made on the 6.1 form.
Monitor this inbox DAILY after submission - clarification and cure windows run from the buyer's email timestamp.

fields_table.field_label: TOTAL BID PRICE (on the face of the form)
fields_table.guidance: Carry the total over EXACTLY from the pricing schedule and write it on the face of this form. Fills automatically when an erp Quotation is linked on the bid; verify it matches the schedule to the cent.

fields_table.field_label: Proof of signing authority attached (board/members' resolution)
fields_table.guidance: Some buyers require the resolution signed by ALL directors.
Complete only if the bidder is a foreign supplier; otherwise mark N/A - never remove pages.
Signed by the authorised signatory named in the board/members' resolution. Attach proof of signing authority - failure renders the tender non-responsive.
Date on the day of actual signature.

name: SBD6.1
instructions: Confirm the points system from the TENDER-SPECIFIC clause, not the boilerplate: 80/20 up to and including R50 million (all taxes included), 90/10 above. Read the buyer's OWN specific-goals table - never assume the standard B-BBEE scale.

fields_table.guidance: Names must match CIPC, CSD and the B-BBEE evidence EXACTLY - a mismatch is treated as misrepresentation at some buyers.

Computed from your estimated value against the R50m threshold. 'Straddling' means your price could fall either side - build a points strategy that works under BOTH systems and ask the SCM contact in writing which applies.
Determines the evidence: sworn affidavit on the DTIC template (EME/QSE, valid 12 months) or SANAS-accredited certificate.
Evidence must be valid at closing. If it is not ready at deadline and B-BBEE is not a pre-qualification gate in this pack, STILL SUBMIT - missing proof only zeroes the points.

fields_table.field_label: Points claimed per specific goal (write the NUMBER against each goal)
fields_table.guidance: Write the number of points claimed against EACH goal - some buyers reject ticks, and 'non-claiming of points on this form will lead to zero even if means of verification is attached'.

A claim without the exact proof scores zero. Ownership goals often ALSO need shareholding certificates, certified shareholder IDs, CIPC documents and a current CSD report; locality needs a municipal account/lease matching CSD/CIPC exactly.

fields_table.field_label: Subcontracting declaration (25%/30% cap to lower-scoring enterprises)
fields_table.guidance: You may not subcontract more than the stated cap to an enterprise without equal-or-better points unless declared - read the pack's number.

NEVER inflate a claim: fraudulent preference claims carry disqualification, contract cancellation, up to 10-year restriction from all public-sector business, and criminal referral. Signed by the authorised signatory named in the board/members' resolution. Attach proof of signing authority - failure renders the tender non-responsive.
Date on the day of actual signature.
